scope: Original-terminal, independently granted native hardware policy with current protected Admin history, real adapters, retained resource exclusion and explicit uncertainty recovery
implementation: Three distinct finite activities hardware.inspect, hardware.apply and hardware.restore use closed versioned hardware selectors. Review data, copied grants, device hashes and old observations are not authorization. The original enrolled Admin independently authenticates through the existing nonrenewable standard 30-second PAM session

One immutable private request binds an actual luma-hardware transient unit, original controlling terminal, account and closed Task. The fixed native entrypoints hardware-run, hardware-console and hardware-cleanup have no arbitrary path, command, destination, environment or unit-property interface; the installed console requires enforcing AppArmor, zero capabilities, no-new-privileges, seccomp and its exact bounded process generation

Stable human-reviewed plans bind the exact logical slot, actual device/daemon and boot generation, adapter/source/capability digests, original baseline, changed setting, actor generation, two independent finite grants, expected revision and bounded lifetime. Actual activation stopwatch values are added only inside the authenticated Prepare transition, not borrowed from a serialized receipt

Prepare durably records exact undo before any physical dispatch. A separate TPM-authenticated DispatchStarted records each one-use Apply or Restore attempt, including an exact unique daemon/process generation for external calls. Applied and Restored require actual exact readback and CAS revision progression; generic Admin catalog submission cannot manufacture hardware events

CPU quota and weight and exact whole-backing-device I/O limits operate on only the two compiled worker parent slices. Parent ceilings remain within two CPUs and 64 MiB/s, without weakening original leaf memory, pids, CPU or I/O guardians or changing recorded reservations

The resource Manager retains the original exclusive OFD and exact intent before descriptor delivery, and independently revalidates current TPM history, protected UTC, non-hardware authority fingerprint, finite grant/assignment deadlines, original nonrenewed allocation window, controller pidfd/executable/profile/unit, parent generation and actual scalar readback. Only the first one second of a committed dispatch tolerates before/after transition states. Death, deadline, revocation, drift or unknown observation fences the controller and revokes bound execution while retaining exclusion and physical charges

Memory changes require complete worker/guardian/request drainage and the same currently admitted compiled model profile. They cannot select weights, switch profiles or expand the envelope; both the original undo baseline and applied envelope remain within the compiled 4,831,838,208-byte parent bound

Network changes require complete drainage and act only on fixed systemd slice IPAddressAllow between empty and exact IPv4/IPv6 localhost prefixes, while deny-any remains unchanged. Independent query-only helpers verify actual attached/effective ingress and egress BPF programs, retained ancestor filters and replacement of the old own effective program IDs after a changed policy; D-Bus properties alone are not completion

The fixed Intel i915/eDP backlight adapter checks real protected sysfs/PCI/driver identities and requested versus actual brightness without extinguishing the display. The pinned PPD 0.21-1ubuntu3 adapter permits only actual supported balanced/power-saver profiles with no holds. Unsupported or changed devices refuse instead of selecting a fallback driver

Immutable image-writer mediation covers both PPD D-Bus aliases, login1 brightness, Polkit and udev inputs. Fresh read-only fixed-role daemon observers verify exact live systemd, system-bus and power-daemon executable generations; the separate SYS_PTRACE observer does not access Admin, resource or TPM state or broaden the existing capability-free credential observer

A bounded physical callback holds current Admin/NV authority only for one original suspend-aware operation budget of at most one second. Nested observer, bus and BPF calls cannot reset that budget. Neither a read/write API nor these observations is an atomic device CAS against trusted root, firmware or daemon-internal changes; drift remains fenced

Normal expiry or explicit cancellation attempts a fresh RestoreStarted and exact undo only within the same still-current original PAM session. Precommitted scalar/sysfs cleanup can independently verify current NV and the original same-boot exclusion within the cleanup window, but cannot issue grants, append new Admin signatures, declare a transaction terminal or release physical charges

An external D-Bus timeout does not cancel queued effects. Fresh-connection automatic cleanup does not replay any external mutation after a dispatch. Ambiguous external Apply/Restore remains a protected obligation until fresh independently granted Admin recovery proves the exact old daemon process generation has exited or the old boot has ended, and re-observes the explicitly reviewed state or qualified kernel-path absence. No guaranteed automatic undo is claimed

Terminal restored state requires the original baseline, while independently granted reconciliation may explicitly retain reviewed external/new-generation state or qualified absence. A lost finish acknowledgement or old controller death cannot by itself release a resource charge; current protected terminal state permits retirement of only the Manager's configuration reference, and physical drainage remains independently required
